holds.reason: Yerushalmi Bava Metzia 2:5:3 has a Shimon ben Shetah in its lost-jewel narrative. The naked reference supplies no independent basis to construe that figure as an amora or to merge this notice with the tannaitic entry.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
